independent_evaluation_model.description: Clean rendered observations are perturbed by arbitrary state-response vectors, alternative morphologies, Gaussian/impulsive noise, registration, missing-state, coverage and reference-anchor failures. Residue optical constants are not reused.
independent_evaluation_model.remaining_coupling: Clean backgrounds and inference code are shared; this is stronger than an in-model split but is not independent hardware data.

in_model_regression.warning: This audit reuses the retained forward model and is an internal regression only; the domain-shift audit is the stronger synthetic challenge.

adversarial_search.interpretation: Search distribution is deliberately artificial; this is a boundary attack, not a prevalence or physical limit-of-detection estimate.

pre_registered_decision_rule: At each acquired stage any pixel FLAG makes the FOV FLAG. PASS requires a named complete certificate, valid dated reference anchors, valid coverage, no failed required state, and at least 95% visible pixels PASS; otherwise UNKNOWN.
